description: Save or dismiss lines from get_task memory_suggestions, as your human answered. Saved lines join the space's or the brand's memory and reach every chat there; a dismissed line is not suggested again there. Returns each line's state; one answered in the app already keeps that answer.

dismiss.description: memory_suggestions ids your human said no to.

save.description: memory_suggestions ids your human said to keep.

name: answer_memory
title: Answer memory suggestions
